description: This Java class extends SafeDeleteProcessorDelegateBase to handle safe deletion of Android resource files within an IntelliJ IDEA plugin, including identifying resource directories, finding usages, and handling user prompts for deleting related resource files.

classes.name: AndroidResourceFileSafeDeleteProcessor
classes.description: A class that manages safe deletion of Android resource files, handling usage search, related resource files, and user prompts within the IDE.

methods.name: getElementsToSearch
methods.description: Returns the collection of elements to search for usages, typically the element itself.

methods.name: handlesElement
methods.description: Determines if the processor can handle the given PsiElement, specifically if it's an Android resource file in a resource directory.

methods.name: findUsages
methods.description: Finds usages of the element to be deleted, including resource fields if the element is a file.

methods.name: getAdditionalElementsToDelete
methods.description: Finds additional resource files related to the element, optionally asking the user for confirmation.

methods.name: findConflicts
methods.description: Checks for conflicts before deletion; returns null indicating no conflicts.

methods.name: preprocessUsages
methods.description: Preprocesses usages before deletion; returns the usages unchanged.

methods.name: prepareForDeletion
methods.description: Prepares the element for deletion; empty implementation.

methods.name: isToSearchInComments
methods.description: Checks if search in comments is enabled for safe delete.

methods.name: isToSearchForTextOccurrences
methods.description: Checks if search for text occurrences is enabled for safe delete.

methods.name: setToSearchInComments
methods.description: Sets whether to search in comments during safe delete.

methods.name: setToSearchForTextOccurrences
methods.description: Sets whether to search for text occurrences during safe delete.
